bifrost: springboard/ui/src/tensor.rs, springboard/ui/src/features.rs, springboard/ui/src/compute.rs (pure models in bifrost-ui; no SDK API and no model runner yet). Nearest other code: springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs (prefix trie and bigram counts, not a learned model), springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (word checks, no model)
summary: Core ML runs trained models on the device (MLModel, feature providers, tensors, compute-device policy, on-device updates). BifrOSt now has the data types a model would use (a tensor, typed feature values and providers, batches, and a compute-device placement policy), all in bifrost-ui and std-only. It still has no model loading, no inference, no SDK module, and no on-device update path, so the framework stays partial.

features.note: no SDK API loads a compiled model or runs a prediction

features.apple: MLFeatureValue, MLSendableFeatureValue, MLFeatureProvider, MLDictionaryFeatureProvider, MLBatchProvider, MLArrayBatchProvider
features.note: typed values (int, double, text, tensor), a dictionary provider, a batch of providers and a check against declared inputs. No sendable value type, no model description and no sequence or dictionary values
row-major f32 tensor with shape, reshape, slicing along one axis, and pointwise min and max on equal shapes. No broadcasting, no Boolean or integer scalars, no arithmetic or matrix operations

features.apple: MLComputeDevice, MLCPUComputeDevice, MLGPUComputeDevice, MLNeuralEngineComputeDevice, MLComputePlan, MLComputePolicy
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/compute.rs (device and policy model); springboard/src/gpu/ (GPU presenter, rendering only)
features.note: a placement model: CPU and GPU devices, an automatic and a CPU-only policy, and the first allowed device that an operation supports. Nothing runs on a device yet, and no Neural Engine exists on this platform
no state buffers for recurrent models
no training or fine-tuning path in the SDK

features.feature: Downloading and compiling a model at runtime

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (spelling only); springboard/src/media/hwdec/vaapi.rs (video decode, not inference)
features.note: no image classification, speech, sound or sentiment API; the spellcheck module is dictionary-based

features.feature: Text prediction on the on-screen keyboard
features.apple: No direct Core ML API; typical Core ML text model use

features.apple: Create ML, Core ML Tools, Analyzing a Core ML model's performance in Xcode
features.note: these are Apple developer tools tied to Xcode; no BifrOSt counterpart is expected
depends on Apple's model deployment service

gaps: No SDK API to load a model file and run a prediction (MLModel, MLFeatureProvider); the value and tensor types exist only in bifrost-ui
No model description to check inputs and outputs against a real model file; the check takes a list of declared features from the caller
Tensors have no broadcasting, arithmetic, Boolean or integer scalars (MLTensor, MLTensorScalar)
Compute placement is a model only: nothing runs on a CPU or GPU compute device through it, and no Neural Engine exists on this platform
No domain APIs on top of inference: image classification, speech, sound analysis, natural language
No model encryption, runtime model download and compile, or on-device update path
The on-device keyboard predictor is not a learned model; the Assistant app uses a remote API, which is not Core ML
